in_hebrew.name: Birck
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Bright, Shining Rock
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Birck הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German word ‘berihan’, meaning bright or shining. The addition of the Old English word ‘roc’ or ‘rock’ results in the name Birck, which symbolizes a shining or bright rock.

in_greek.name: Birck
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Bright, Shining Rock
in_greek.long_meaning: Birck είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old German word ‘berihan’, meaning bright or shining. The addition of the Old English word ‘roc’ or ‘rock’ results in the name Birck, which symbolizes a shining or bright rock.

in_latin.name: Birck
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Bright, Shining Rock
in_latin.long_meaning: Birck est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old German word ‘berihan’, meaning bright or shining. The addition of the Old English word ‘roc’ or ‘rock’ results in the name Birck, which symbolizes a shining or bright rock.
